$comment: Residual cause census for the committed ACTIVITY oracle corpus, RE-CENSUSED by activity-swimlane-rendering T7 (2026-09-09) after landing T1-T6 (swimlane skinparams, content-fitted lane widths, lane placement, divider-and-floating-title chrome). The prior re-census was activity-style-defaults T7. Every number is a pure function of the committed corpus at measuredAgainstCommit: each of the 268 status:"baseline" fixtures in diff-baseline.json is rendered through render-fixture-activity.ts#renderFixtureActivity with a DeterministicMeasurer and fixtureIncludeStore(), and compared with compareSvg(ours, golden, 'deterministic'). Paths are normalised by replacing every positional index with [], so svg/g[1]/rect[3]/@x and svg/g[1]/rect[7]/@x are one family. RANKED BY WEIGHT, NOT COUNT. The narrative sections (exitBarFamilies, geometryResidual, childCountResidual, namedFamilies) are carried forward from the prior census unchanged except where restated below; paths and topFixturesByWeight are fresh. RE-COMPUTED by activity-min-box-width T6 (2026-09-09) from the same measurement as diff-baseline.json: aggregate 43977. RE-PINNED by activity-parallel-connectors T6 (2026-09-10).

descent.note: The activity-parallel-connectors headline. Before = 43977, the figure activity-min-box-width T6 pinned (b7c293c6) and which this mission stated its exit bar against. After = this measurement, post T0-T5. Fork/split branches are connected by vertical drops at their own in/out x, gated per branch on hasPointOut() (ParallelBuilderSplit.java:194-203,246-261; ParallelBuilderFork.java:151-163,202-216; FtileGeometry.java:141-143); pushEdge dedupes consecutive exactly-equal points (Worm.java:262-266); the fork bar is a 6-high #555 rounded block (AbstractParallelFtilesBuilder.java:64; FtileBlackBlock.java:101-110; plantuml.skin:387) and the split a 1.5-high thin line spanning first..last clamped to the composite centre (FtileThinSplit.java:61,81-91; ParallelBuilderSplit.java:104-109,171-176), drawn AFTER the branches (ParallelBuilderFork.java:101,117); branches are margined 14 per side and centred in maxH + 40 (AbstractParallelFtilesBuilder.java:129-130; FtileHeightFixedCentered.java:88-98) and packed with no other gap (FtileForkInner.java:90-113), so the uncompressed 28 px inter-branch gap stands where the jar shows 10 after CompressionXorYBuilder (C2, filed); cross-lane parallel connectors jog at +4 / -14 (ParallelBuilderFork.java:178,235). Only the 32 fork/split fixtures moved: 29 fell, 1 unchanged, TWO rose and were adopted with their mechanisms (bixefi-77-moki051 181 -> 220 and gesogi-81-xoma900 242 -> 248: the C2 packing widths, plus the filed parser lane-capture defect at node-dispatch.ts:261/:291 that puts a fork/split bar in the LAST branch lane instead of the lane at fork/split). The 236 non-parallel fixtures moved zero.

exitBarFamilies.note: The families activity-parallel-connectors named (README exit bar) over the 32 split/fork fixtures (subset) and all 268 (aggregate), before (b7c293c6) and after this re-pin. Weights sum every path ending in the family suffix. svg/g[][childCount] on the subset fell 3733 -> 2116 (no join edge for a branch without an out point; the join bar drawn after the branches). polygon[]/@points fell 313 -> 300. line[]/@y1/@y2 fell by 1 each; line[]/@x1/@x2 ROSE 596 -> 605 / 595 -> 605: the uncompressed 28 px packing (C2), the filed lane-capture parser defect, and the comparator now descending into fixtures where a childCount mismatch used to short-circuit it (compareSvg's count is non-monotonic across that boundary), so attribute-family totals are not comparable across it while the gated weightedScore is.

geometryResidual.note: Re-derived by activity-min-box-width T6 from style-baseline.json's canvases. Width was wider=168 / narrower=99 / equal=1 and is now wider=72 / narrower=194 / equal=2; height was shorter=198 / taller=69 / equal=1 and is now shorter=188 / taller=79 / equal=1. Deleting the 120px floor moved the width residual from systematically too WIDE toward too NARROW; the remaining constant is LAYOUT_MARGIN 12 against the jar's 16 (activity-canvas-margin, filed earlier).

childCountResidual.note: svg/g[][childCount]'s share of total weight is 44.7% after this mission (39.9% before it; 91.6% at the aeg T0). 201 of 268 fixtures still carry a root-group child-count mismatch. The remaining weight is missing content and the defects named in .agent-notes/aeg-T1-8-exceptions.md, plus the zero-length split-connector segments the routing helper's float-equality shortcut emits once branch widths are text-fitted (filed).

namedFamilies.finding: We resolve theme.colors.background to #FFFFFF where the jar resolves #1B1B1B, so the root style/background carries the wrong colour AND the background rect the jar paints under its own paintBackcolor guard (SvgGraphics.java:186-192) is correctly declined on our resolved white. The guard is faithful; its INPUT is wrong. Found by T5 while verifying the guard, handed to this census.
namedFamilies.correction: The T5 decision-journal entry names velodu-59-sada437 as a second instance of this family. It is NOT one: that fixture's golden is the jar's OWN graphical error page (green-on-black, PSystemError styling), it is pinned status:"jar-error" in diff-baseline.json, and it contributes no number to this census at all. Its #000000 background is the error page's, not a resolved theme. Verified at T6, not inherited. skinparam mode dark occurs on exactly ONE fixture in the whole 373-fixture corpus.

namedFamilies.finding: The only surviving root-attribute VALUE diff besides background. Source sets `skinparam preserveAspectRatio xMinYMid slice`; the jar emits that verbatim on the root, we emit the hardcoded default `none`. Not a missing attribute -- the document shell emits all 7 root attributes on all 268 fixtures (verified) -- an unported skinparam.

The only surviving svg/defs[1][childCount] diff, and the opposite of the pre-mission one: OUR defs is empty (0) and the JAR's holds 1 child. Source is `skinparam activity { BackgroundColor red-green }`; the jar expands the two-colour form into a <linearGradient> in defs and fills the rect with url(#...). We emit no gradient. Confirms the D6 change was right in general -- 267 of 268 goldens have an EMPTY defs, matching ours -- and isolates the one shape that needs it.
